title: LinkedIn Company Finder by Domain - Input
description: Resolve website domains to verified LinkedIn company pages

domains.title: Website Domains
domains.description: Websites to resolve, with or without protocol/paths (e.g. stripe.com, https://www.vercel.com/about). Duplicates are collapsed automatically. Maximum 50,000 per run.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: resolve: find each domain's LinkedIn page once. monitor: same, then diff against your previous run (new companies, headcount and name changes) for free. Monitoring snapshots live in a named key-value store in your account.

monitorBatchId.title: Monitor Batch ID
monitorBatchId.description: Named group of domains to monitor together when mode is 'monitor' (e.g. 'prospects-q4'). Runs with the same batch id diff against each other.

forceRefresh.title: Force Refresh
forceRefresh.description: Ignore the resolution cache and re-resolve every domain. Cached resolutions from the last 30 days are normally returned instantly and free of charge.

cacheTtlDays.title: Cache TTL (days)
cacheTtlDays.description: How long a resolved mapping is reused before it is refreshed automatically.

includeUnresolved.title: Include Unresolved Domains
includeUnresolved.description: Emit one row per unresolved domain (confidence=low, charged $0) so you can see coverage. Turn off to receive only billed rows.

maxDomains.title: Max Domains Per Run
maxDomains.description: Hard cap on domains processed in this run. Split larger lists into multiple runs.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Domains processed in parallel. Higher is faster; above 25 some sites start rate-limiting.

useVpsRender.title: Use VPS Rendering Lane
useVpsRender.description: Allow the optional VPS lane (JavaScript-rendered pages and persistent cache). The actor works fully without it; this only adds coverage for SPA homepages.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Uses Apify Proxy automatically (GOOGLE_SERP + RESIDENTIAL groups). Override only if you have a specific requirement.
